settings.name: Remember device status before the power failure
settings.description: This parameter determines how the Wall Plug will react in the event of power supply failure.

settings.name: Overload safety switch
settings.description: This function allows to turn off the controlled device in case of exceeding the defined power.

settings.name: Power reporting
settings.description: This parameter determines the minimum percentage change in active power consumption (in relation to the previously reported) that will result in sending new power report.

settings.name: Energy reporting threshold
settings.description: This parameter determines the minimum change in energy consumption (in relation to the previously reported) that will result in sending a new report.

settings.name: Periodic power reporting
settings.description: This parameter defines time period between independent reports sent when changes in power load have not been recorded or if changes are insignificant. By default reports are sent every hour.

settings.name: Periodic energy reporting
settings.description: This parameter defines time period between independent reports sent when changes in power load have not been recorded or if changes are insignificant. By default reports are sent every hour.

settings.name: Measuring energy consumed by the Wall Plug itself
settings.description: This parameter determines whether power metering should include the amount of power consumed by the Wall Plug itself. Results are being added to the value of power consumed by controlled device.

settings.name: UP value - "On/Off (Power)" association group (3)
settings.description: Upper power threshold, used in parameter 23. UP value cannot be lower than a value specified in parameter 22.

settings.name: DOWN value - "On/Off (Power)" association group (3)
settings.description: Lower power threshold, used in parameter 23. DOWN value cannot be higher than a value specified in parameter 21.

settings.name: Controlling "On/Off (Power)" association group (3)
settings.description: This parameter defines the way that 3rd association group devices are controlled. Depends on the actual measured power (according to parameters 21 and 22 settings).

send_if_power_exceeds.text: Send frame (with value set in parameter 26) only if power exceeded value of parameter 21

send_if_power_drops.text: Send frame (with value set in parameter 27) only if power dropped below value of parameter 22

settings.name: SWITCH ON value - "On/Off (Button)" association group (2)
settings.description: The value of BASIC SET command frame sent to the devices associated in 2nd group "On/Off (Button)" when turning the device ON using the button.

settings.name: SWITCH OFF value - "On/Off (Button)" association group (2)
settings.description: The value of BASIC SET command frame sent to the devices associated in 2nd group "On/Off (Button)" when turning the device ON using the button.

settings.name: THRESHOLD UP value - "On/Off (Button)" association group (2)
settings.description: The value of BASIC SET command frame sent to the devices associated in 3rd group "On/Off (Power)" if power exceeded value of parameter 21.

settings.name: THRESHOLD DOWN value - "On/Off (Button)" association group (2)
settings.description: The value of BASIC SET command frame sent to the devices associated in 3rd group "On/Off (Power)" if power dropped below value of parameter 22.

settings.name: Active alarms
settings.description: Define Z-Wave network alarms to which the Wall Plug will respond.

settings.name: Response to alarm frames
settings.description: This parameter defines how the Wall Plug will respond to alarms (device's status change).

settings.name: Alarm state duration
settings.description: This parameter specifies the duration of alarm state. If a device sending an alarm frame through the Z-Wave network sets alarm duration as well, this settings are ignored.

settings.name: Power load for violet color
settings.description: This parameter determines maximum active power value, which when exceeded, causes the LED frame to flash violet. Function is active only when parameter 41 is set to 1 or 2.

settings.name: LED frame color when controlled device is on
settings.description: When set to 1 or 2, LED frame color will change depending on active power and parameter 40. Other colors are set permanently and do not depend on power consumption.

color_change_smooth.text: Color changes smoothly depending on active power

color_change_steps.text: Color changes in steps depending on active power

settings.name: LED frame color at the Z-Wave network alarm detection
settings.description: This parameter defines the illumination color in case of Z-Wave alarm.

color_change_smooth.text: LED frame is illuminated with a color corresponding to the last measured power, before the controlled device was turned off.

settings.name: LED frame color when controlled device is off
settings.description: This parameter defines the illumination color after turning off.

color_change_smooth.text: No change in color. LED frame color is determined by settings of parameters 41 or 42
